questions.question: Article 80 of the Constitution of India lays down the maximum strength of Rajya Sabha as:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**250.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Composition/Strength of Rajya Sabha:**

 
 
• **Article 80 of the Constitution lays down the maximum strength of Rajya Sabha as 250.**
 
• **Out of 250 seats of Rajya Sabha, 12 members are nominated by the President and 238 are representatives of the States and of the two Union Territories.** 
 
• **The present strength of Rajya Sabha is 245,** out of which 233 are representatives of the States and Union territories of Delhi and Puducherry and 12 are nominated by the President.
 
• **The members nominated by the President **are persons having special knowledge or practical experience in respect of such matters as** literature, science, art and social service. **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha (Council of States):**

 
 
• **The Government of India Act, 1919 provided for the creation of a ‘Council of State’ as a second chamber of the then legislature.**
 
• Rajya Sabha is the **Upper house of the bicameral Parliament of India.**
 
• **Allocation of Seats:**
 
 
• The **Fourth Schedule** of the Constitution provides for the allocation of seats to the States and Union Territories in Rajya Sabha. 
 
• **The allocation of seats is made on the basis of the population of each State.**
 
 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Sabha:**

 
 
• Lok Sabha is composed of representatives of the people chosen by **direct election** on the basis of adult suffrage.
 
• **Article 81 of the Constitution defines the composition of the House of the People or Lok Sabha.**
 
• **The maximum strength of the House envisaged by the Constitution is 552.**
 
• **seats of Lok Sabha:**
 
 
• Up to 530 members represent the States
 
• Up to 20 members represent the Union Territories.
 
• Initially, Not more than two members of the Anglo-Indian Community are nominated by the president if this community is not adequately represented in the House.** **
 
• After coming into effect with The Constitution **104th Constitutional Act 2019,** the provision of special representation of the 2 Anglo-Indian community members in the House of the People by nomination has **not been extended further.**
 
 
 
• **The house currently has 543 seats,** which are filled by the election of up to 543 elected members.

• **Salivary amylase breaks down the carbohydrates (starch) into sugars with the help of the grinding action by the teeth.**
 
• **Pancreatic amylase digest the further carbohydrates in the small intestine.**
 
 
 
• **About Vitamins:**

questions.question: A body having very high mass is bound to have high ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** inertia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A body that has** a very high mass** is bound to have** high inertia.**

 
 
• **The tendency of an object to resist changes in its state of motion varies with mass.**
 
• Mass is that quantity that** is solely dependent upon the inertia of an object.**
 
• The **more inertia **that an **object has, the more mass that it has.**
 
• **A more massive object has a greater tendency to resist changes in its state of motion.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Acceleration and Retardation:**

 
 
• **Retardation** is** the opposite of acceleration.**
 
• The body's** velocity might either raise or decrease.**
 
• **Acceleration is the measurement of a change in velocity.**
 
• Acceleration is** stated to be positive when the body's velocity increases.**
 
• The acceleration is** also said to be negative if the velocity decreases.**
 
 
 
• **Velocity** is a **vector quantity** that refers to** "the rate at which an object changes its position."**

• **Macro virus**:
 
 
• A macro virus is a computer virus that is **built in the same macro language that is used by software programs** like Microsoft Excel and word processors like Microsoft Word.
 
• When a macro virus infects a software program, it causes a series of operations to be initiated automatically when the program is launched.
 
 
 
• **Boot Sector virus**:
 
 
• It's a virus that** infects floppy discs' boot sector or hard drives' Master Boot Record (MBR)**.
